description: Agent preflight: check a delegation or mandate document before you act under it. Input text, fields (grantee, scope as text or actions with their own cap, expiry and approval, caps, expiry, revocation, approvals) or both. The signed report marks the grantee, scope of actions, caps, expiry, revocation terms and approval requirements present, missing or ambiguous, with quotes, and names every delegated action with no cap and every term with no expiry. POST /api/delegation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The delegation as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that element.

anyOf.description: Approvals the grantee needs before acting.

approvals.description: Approval requirements, as text or a list.

anyOf.description: Caps that apply across the delegation.

caps.description: Caps that apply across the delegation, as text or a list.

expiry.description: When the delegation ends, for example "2026-12-31" or "90 days from 2026-11-01".

grantee.description: Who receives the authority: a name, agent ID, wallet or other identifier.

revocation.description: How and when the grantor can revoke the delegation.

action.description: The delegated action, for example "book travel".

cap.description: Optional cap on this action, for example "USD 1,200 per trip".

expiry.description: Optional expiry of this action, for example "2026-12-31".

scope.description: The scope of actions: the text, or up to 50 actions as text or {action, cap, expiry, approval}.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The delegation or mandate document as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_delegation-check
title: Delegation check
